method: Prompt changed only to add the alt_text instruction (inserted between the caption and photo_category instructions) — the caption instruction itself and players[]/quality/visible_text instructions are byte-for-byte unchanged from the prior ADR 0006 receipt. Ran the real, updated prompt through the live gemini-2.5-flash-lite model on 10 real DWdCET (Milliken at North Central) photos already live in production (this album has 43 rows in production today, confirmed via a read-only row count) — no database write; this reprocesses the same frames through the local, unmerged code to prove the prompt, not new/never-seen photos. Read each of the 10 source images directly and checked its caption against it. 10/10 passed inspectCaption (0 issues) — no relationship/emotion/outcome/aesthetic/swimwear claims, all under 30 words. 8 of 10 named at least one jersey number. Two defects observed and left recorded, both pre-existing vision-model limitations independent of this change: DSC09426's caption misreads jersey #11 as #17 (a number-legibility error, not a contract violation, confirmed by reading the frame at full resolution); DSC09432, 09435, and 09437 mislabel the action verb (serve vs. set vs. spike) despite correctly reading colors, numbers, and scene — the same three photos show the identical verb error in their alt_text, so this is a caption/vision-model defect, not introduced by the alt_text addition.
scope: 10 DWdCET/Milliken photos (already in production, 43 rows), real model, no DB write
